freeze_policy.evidence_rule: Only information with a defensible publication/observation time at or before the match-specific freeze may enter the model.
freeze_policy.lineup_rule: Confirmed XI may enter only if it was publicly available by T-60min; otherwise use earlier availability/probable-XI information only.
freeze_policy.result_rule: Target-match score, events, post-match reports, and any information first published after freeze are forbidden until all nine predictions are frozen.
freeze_policy.same_day_rule: Earlier matches on the same calendar day are not injected into later matches unless an exact completion timestamp proves they were completed before that later match's T-60 freeze.

inputs_to_reconstruct: all model-native historical state strictly before freeze
pre-match availability/injury/suspension information timestamped before freeze
confirmed XI only when demonstrably available before freeze
pre-match market information only when its timestamp is defensibly before freeze
